info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Tax Administration API
info.description: The Enterprise Tax Administration API enables efficient management of tax-related processes within enterprises. This API facilitates the submission and tracking of tax filings, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include finance and accounting departments looking to streamline their tax operations and enhance reporting accuracy. By leveraging this API, organizations can automate their tax administration tasks, leading to improved efficiency and reduced risks associated with tax compliance.

post.summary: Create a new enterprise tax administration record.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new entry in the enterprise tax administration system. It is designed for financial administrators to efficiently set up and manage tax information for enterprises.
